name: Passaging Organoid Cultures

usage.en: Dissociate and re-plate BME2/Matrigel-embedded organoids to expand a culture; use when domes are dense or organoids are large/dark-centred, not for single-cell dissociation (stop at small clumps to preserve viability).
usage.zh: 把包埋在基质胶（BME2/Matrigel）里的类器官解离并重新铺板以扩增培养；在圆顶致密、类器官变大或中心发暗时传代，不用于单细胞解离（解离到小细胞团即停，保活力）。

materials.name: Organoid culture in BME2/Matrigel domes (6-well plate)
BME2 / Matrigel (basement membrane extract), kept on ice
Swinging-bucket centrifuge, 37°C incubator, microscope, cool block

components.name: 1. Assess domes; add TrypLE to wells
6. Resuspend in 80% BME2 and plate as droplets
7. Set BME2 at 37°C, add medium, return to incubator

note.en: No true stopping point — organoids should be moving through dissociation → plating in one continuous sitting. Do not leave dissociated organoids in TrypLE.
note.zh: 无真正的暂停点——解离→铺板应一次连续完成。不要让解离后的类器官长时间停留在 TrypLE 中。

detailedSteps.en: Assess the domes under a microscope to decide split ratio (typically **1:2–1:3**; split to the same or fewer wells if organoids are growing slowly). Aspirate medium and add **1–2 mL TrypLE per well** of a 6-well plate. If domes have already detached, or there are many free-floating cells/organoids or attached fibroblasts, first collect medium + organoids into a tube and pellet before adding TrypLE.
detailedSteps.zh: 镜下评估圆顶以决定分传比例（通常 **1:2–1:3**；生长慢时传到相同或更少的孔）。吸去培养基，每孔（6 孔板）加 **1–2 mL TrypLE**。若圆顶已脱落、或培养基中有大量游离细胞/类器官或贴壁成纤维细胞，先把培养基+类器官收进管里离心成团，再加 TrypLE。

detailedSteps.en: Using a P1000, detach the BME2 domes from the plate (a **cell scraper** is recommended when passaging many plates). Pipette the suspension up and down several times to break organoids out of the BME2, then transfer to an appropriately sized tube with a P1000 or a 10 mL stripette.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 P1000 把 BME2 圆顶从板底刮离（传很多板时推荐用**细胞刮刀**）。反复吹打几次让类器官从 BME2 中脱出，再用 P1000 或 10 mL 血清移液管转入合适大小的管中。

detailedSteps.en: Wash the wells with **~1 mL TrypLE per well** to collect remaining organoids and add to the collection tube.
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔再用 **~1 mL TrypLE** 冲洗，收集残余类器官并入收集管。

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at **37°C**. Check under the microscope after 5 min, then as needed; pipette up and down with a P1000 to aid dissociation. **Stop when organoids are broken into small clumps of cells — avoid dissociating to single cells** (single cells hurt recovery).
detailedSteps.zh: **37°C** 温育。5 min 后镜检，随后按需查看；用 P1000 反复吹打助解离。**当类器官解离成小细胞团时即停——避免打成单细胞**（单细胞会降低恢复率）。
detailedSteps.warning: ⚠️ Over-digestion to single cells markedly reduces re-formation efficiency.

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at **800 × g for 2 min**. Aspirate the supernatant, leaving the organoid pellet. If the suspension does not pellet cleanly or a grey BME2 haze sits above the pellet, aspirate as much as possible, resuspend in **ice-cold PBS**, and repeat the spin.
detailedSteps.zh: **800 × g 离心 2 min**。吸去上清，留下类器官沉淀。若不易成团、或沉淀上方有灰色 BME2 雾层，尽量吸除，用**冰冷 PBS** 重悬后再离心一次。

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend the pellet in **80% BME2** (~**200 µL per well** of a 6-well plate). Resuspend in a small volume first to break up the pellet, then top up with BME2. **Keep BME2 cold** (use a cool block) — it sets at room temperature — and dispense quickly. Avoid bubbles.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 **80% BME2** 重悬沉淀（6 孔板每孔约 **200 µL**）。先用少量重悬打散沉淀，再补足 BME2。**BME2 全程保持低温**（用冷块）——室温会凝固——并尽快分装。避免气泡。

detailedSteps.en: Using a P200, dispense **200 µL organoid/BME2 per well** as **10–15 µL droplets**. Place the plate in a **37°C, 5% CO₂** incubator for **15–30 min** to let the BME2 set.
detailedSteps.zh: 用 P200 每孔滴 **200 µL 类器官/BME2**，做成 **10–15 µL 的小液滴**。将板放入 **37°C、5% CO₂** 培养箱 **15–30 min** 使 BME2 凝固。

detailedSteps.en: Add **2 mL of the appropriate organoid medium per well** and return to the incubator. Change medium twice a week until ready to passage again.
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔加 **2 mL 相应类器官培养基**，放回培养箱。之后每周换液两次，直到可再次传代。

briefSteps.en: TrypLE onto domes → detach & pipette out organoids → 37°C dissociate to small clumps → 800×g 2 min pellet → resuspend in 80% BME2 → plate 10–15 µL droplets → set 37°C 15–30 min → add medium
briefSteps.zh: TrypLE 加到圆顶 → 刮离并吹出类器官 → 37°C 解离成小团 → 800×g 2 min 成团 → 80% BME2 重悬 → 滴 10–15 µL 液滴 → 37°C 凝固 15–30 min → 加培养基

notes.en: Developed by the organoid derivation team at the Wellcome Sanger Institute, mainly for cancer organoids. Use low split ratios (1:2–1:3); passage to the same or fewer wells if organoids grow poorly. 5 mL Eppendorf tubes help maintain sterility. If pellets stay hazy with residual BME2, a cold-PBS wash and re-spin resolves it. Keeping a bottle of cold PBS in the fridge is handy.
notes.zh: 由 Wellcome Sanger 研究所类器官团队开发，主要用于癌症类器官。用低分传比（1:2–1:3）；生长不佳时传到相同或更少的孔。5 mL Eppendorf 管有助保持无菌。若沉淀因残余 BME2 发雾，用冷 PBS 洗一次再离心即可。冰箱常备一瓶冷 PBS 很方便。

ref: Rogers H, Letchford L, Vieira S, et al. Passaging cancer organoid cultures. protocols.io (Wellcome Sanger Institute)

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1–1.5 小时，实操: 45 分钟
